about: Realistic customer reports for an end-to-end quality test: what customers say to Mia (one reply per question, in their own words) and the documents they upload. 'expected' is the next step a claims expert gives after reading the same material under the current rules (quote limit EUR 1,200; high-voltage battery repairs need a person). Labels were written before the system was run on these cases, and the reading rules were not tuned to them.

replies.what_happened: I reversed out of a parking space at the supermarket and hit a concrete pillar. The rear bumper is dented.
replies.quote_itemized: Yes, it lists the parts and the labour.
replies.incident_report: Yes, I have the police report.

cases.why: Single car, no injury, itemized quote of EUR 640, report available.

replies.what_happened: A hail storm left dents all over the roof and the bonnet.
replies.injury: No one was in the car.
replies.repair_kind: Bodywork, the roof and the bonnet.
replies.quote_amount: About 1,150 euros according to the quote.
replies.incident_report: No, there's no police report for hail.

cases.why: The policy requires an incident report; the customer has none.

replies.what_happened: I hit a kerb hard and since then the car shows a battery warning.
replies.repair_kind: The garage says the high-voltage battery pack has to be replaced.

cases.why: High-voltage battery repair and a quote far over the limit.

replies.what_happened: I was rear-ended at a red light, the other driver drove into me.
replies.fault: Yes, he admitted it was his fault.

cases.why: Quote of EUR 1,480 is over the EUR 1,200 limit.

replies.what_happened: I scraped a wall in an underground garage, the whole left side is scratched.

cases.why: EUR 1,190 is under the limit; everything else is in order.

replies.what_happened: I clipped a parked van's mirror with my mirror and mine broke off. The van was not damaged.
replies.other_party: No, the van was parked and wasn't damaged.

cases.why: EUR 1,200 is at the limit, not over it.

replies.what_happened: Another car pulled out in front of me, I braked hard but still hit it.
replies.injury: My neck hurts a bit since then, I went to see the doctor.
replies.fault: Yes, he agrees he pulled out.
replies.repair_kind: The front bumper and a headlight.

cases.why: An injury is reported (neck pain, doctor visit).

replies.what_happened: We collided at a junction.
replies.fault: No, he says it was my fault, but he ran the red light.
replies.incident_report: Yes, the police wrote a report.

cases.why: Fault is disputed.

replies.what_happened: My car was broken into last night and the navigation system was stolen.
replies.repair_kind: The side window and the dashboard.
replies.incident_report: Yes, I reported it to the police.

cases.why: Theft is not an own-damage claim.

replies.policy_number: I don't have it here, sorry.
replies.what_happened: I reversed into a bollard while parking and dented the bumper.

cases.why: Without a policy number the policy can't be confirmed as active.

replies.what_happened: I scratched the door on a pillar in a car park.
replies.quote_itemized: No, it's just one total amount.

cases.why: The quote is only a total; an itemized quote is required.

replies.what_happened: I hit a post while parking and the rear bumper is dented.
replies.quote_itemized: I'm not sure, I haven't looked closely.
